verdict.rationale: Solid's own repo claims "full SSR and serverless support" and says it supports Node LTS, Deno, and Cloudflare Worker runtimes. That establishes SSR on serverless and edge runtimes. Nothing shows how deployment works, so the "without custom infrastructure setup" part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: documented deployment adapters/presets for serverless and edge platforms, evidence of zero-config deployment, independent or hands-on deployment reports.
